name: Processing Result 28
definition: Outcome of the processing of the transaction.

ResponseCode.name: Response Code
ResponseCode.definition: Detailed results of the processing, conforming to ISO 8583 Response codes list.  This code list is maintained by the ISO 8583/MA (maintenance agency).

ApprovalCode.name: Approval Code
ApprovalCode.definition: Value assigned by the entity when the transaction is approved.

ResponseReason.name: Response Reason
ResponseReason.definition: Contains the reason of the response.

TemporarySecureCardDataReusePermitted.name: Temporary Secure Card Data Reuse Permitted
TemporarySecureCardDataReusePermitted.definition: Issuer permits reuse of temporary secure stored card data.

ActionCode.name: Action Code
ActionCode.definition: Action to be performed based on ISO8583 Action Code.

PrivateData.name: Private Data
PrivateData.definition: Reserved for private data. The use of this data element is determined by bilateral agreement.

NationalData.name: National Data
NationalData.definition: Reserved to define data unique to the country applications.
